column1: # red-expectations.tsv — the D-01 expectation table for scripts/red-runner.
# Provenance: the phase-02 red tests pin the 2026-11-19 v1.0 review's
# Critical findings (REVIEW.md §5: R-01, R-02, R-03; §6: P-01); the phase
# composition that fixes them, in order, is REVIEW.md §15 (red tests first,
# transport/protocol/persistence fixes in Phases 3-5 under them).
# Format: one data row per red-gated test, tab-separated:
#   <test_name><TAB><expected>
# where <expected> is:
#   red   — the test must FAIL while the defect it pins is unfixed; a skip
#           event (env gate failed to open) or an absence is an ERROR;
#   green — the fix has landed; a fail event is an ERROR (the flip IS this
#           one-line change — never the runner script, never the test,
#           per D-01).
# Keep the `grep -v '^#'` discipline for any future count gates over this
# file: data rows carry exactly two tab-separated fields, no trailing
# whitespace, no inline comments.
# Rows (append one per new red test; flip red->green when its fix lands):
